name: Human Gaussian Splatting
definition: A neural rendering framework that represents an animatable human and a static scene using 3D Gaussians, trained on 50-100 frames of monocular video to enable novel view and novel pose synthesis at 60 FPS.
summary: Human Gaussian Splatting is a neural rendering framework that represents animatable human avatars using 3D Gaussians, enabling novel view and pose synthesis at 60 FPS from monocular video without test-time MLP evaluation.
